name: Sigrun Oathflare
loreTies: Oaths give war meaning; courage gives power form.
Oathbound: surviving damage strengthens the next committed strike.
Sigrun Oathflare is a colossal Asgardian deity shaped by oaths give war meaning; courage gives power form. It manifests the Realm's law through battlefield-scale mythic force.
shortBackstory: Thor, Thunder Guardian, is one of the four playable deities of the Asgardian canon. The lore remains the same; the playable form is now the source-realm divinity behind the mythology: thunder god, giant-breaker, protector of holds, hammer-oath guardian.

chapters.title: Origin
chapters.text: Sigrun Oathflare began as more than a weapon in Valhalla Beyond the Veil. Sigrun Oathflare was bound to an oath-stone on the Storm-Oath Bridge during a Gate disturbance that tested whether oaths give war meaning; courage gives power form could survive contact with the Hollow. The title carried in their name was earned when the Titan chose duty over spectacle and accepted a burden ordinary soldiers could not survive.

chapters.title: Faction Bond
chapters.text: Among the Asgardian, Sigrun Oathflare is treated as proof that a storm-oath warrior civilization where vows, endurance, and battle memory shape power can become battlefield doctrine without losing its soul. Their silhouette carries steel, iron, rune markings, storm energy, mountain-forged mass, frost scars, thunder wounds, but their real identity is tactical: durable assault, counterattack, storm pressure, oath-based endurance. Every deployment makes faction philosophy visible through movement, restraint, and force.

chapters.title: Gate Wound
chapters.text: The Gate did not simply attack Sigrun Oathflare; it tried to measure what their Realm values most. The wound echoed sacred doctrine back as bait, tempting the Titan to overextend, break battle line, or turn culture into raw fuel. Sigrun Oathflare survived by refusing the Gate's terms, leaving a scar that still reacts whenever counterattack pressure appears on the map.

chapters.title: Campaign Role
chapters.text: In Storm-Oath Covenant, Sigrun Oathflare gives the campaign a personal lens on faction survival. Their presence reinforces the rule that faction identity stays distinct unless a mission explicitly permits otherwise. In a one-active-deity Titan, Sigrun Oathflare turns Oathbound from a passive rule into a story statement: the Realm is defending its meaning.

chapters.title: Personal Conflict
chapters.text: Sigrun Oathflare's flaw is overcommitment to the belief that their Realm's answer must always be enough. NPC witnesses and rival factions challenge that certainty as the Hollow learns to imitate law, oath, balance, life, radiance, and ambition without understanding any of them. Their battlefield stats support this arc: HP 36, attack 6, range 1, speed 3, energy 3.

relationshipHooks: Hrodda can test whether their courage is oath or vanity.
developmentStatus: Readable profile integrated into dashboard character pages.
mythicSource: source culture humans later copied as Norse myth
visualCanon: Hrodda is an oath-witness shaped by Valkyrie law and skald memory. Her staff, storm-lit eye scar, iron-gray braids, and oath-ring cloak plates should feel like the origin of later human saga judges, not a Viking costume.
